record.one_liner: Clay is a GTM data enrichment and workflow platform that combines data providers, AI research and CRM/outbound automation.
record.auth_notes: Public API requests send a Clay API key in the clay-api-key header. Keys are created under API and CLI > API keys (or clay api-keys create). The legacy account API key does not work with the Public API. Not OAuth.
record.access_notes: Clay API access is listed only on the Enterprise tier, which is custom-priced with an annual commitment and handled by an account team. Launch and Growth plans do not list Public API access (Growth lists HTTP API integrations, which is a different feature). Not verified whether any trial path reaches the Public API.
record.api_notes: Public API base is https://api.clay.com/public/v0 with a documented /me endpoint. Breadth of endpoints not fully surveyed in this pass. Tables also accept per-table webhook ingestion on lower tiers, which is not the public REST API.
record.blocker_notes: Self-serve credentials for the Public API appear to require the Enterprise plan, which is sold through sales. The official MCP server (Claude, ChatGPT, Codex) is a workspace connector governed by admin settings, not a developer-issued API credential. Enterprise pricing is custom and not public.

evidence.quote: Every request to the Clay Public API must include a Clay API key in the clay-api-key header.
